questions.prompt: You want three copies of nginx that get replaced if a container dies. You should create:
choices: Three naked Pods with the same name
A Deployment (replica count + Pod template)
A ClusterIP Service only
A kubeadm control plane
questions.why: A Pod is ephemeral. A Deployment keeps N copies and a ReplicaSet. You almost never create a ReplicaSet yourself.

questions.prompt: A Service of type ClusterIP is reachable from:
choices: Your laptop browser, always
Inside the cluster; use kubectl port-forward (or an Ingress later) from your shell
The public internet via kube-proxy
Only the node that runs etcd
questions.why: ClusterIP is not on your laptop. curl from your shell will not hit it until you port-forward or install an Ingress controller.

questions.prompt: A Service has no endpoints. The usual cause is:
choices: etcd is full
The Service selector does not match the Pod template labels
You used kind instead of kubeadm
The image tag is alpine
questions.why: Matching the Deployment’s own metadata.labels is not enough. The Service must match the Pod template labels. kubectl get pods --show-labels and kubectl get endpoints.

choices: Creates a cluster on your laptop
Installs a client. kind (this module) or a cloud control plane is the cluster
Is the same as kubeadm init
Starts kubelet as a systemd unit
questions.why: kubectl talks HTTP to an API server using a kubeconfig. kubectl config current-context tells you which cluster you are talking to.

questions.prompt: The first cluster in this module is kind because:
choices: kubeadm cannot run nginx
kind is Kubernetes in Docker — enough to learn objects; kubeadm is a Production install path
kind includes an Ingress controller and a load balancer
kind stores state in a Terraform state file
questions.why: A laptop cluster is enough to learn Pod, Deployment, and Service. kubeadm belongs in Production.

questions.prompt: You apply an Ingress object on kind and curl does nothing. Why?
choices: Ingress YAML is invalid on kind
An Ingress object is data; a controller Pod must be running to route traffic, and kind does not install one for you
You must use NodePort instead of any HTTP routing
The Service type must be LoadBalancer on kind
questions.why: kind does not ship an Ingress controller. kubectl get ingress can show the object while no Pod is listening for it.

questions.prompt: A Pod is ImagePullBackOff. First place to look:
choices: Terraform state
kubectl describe pod — Events, then fix the image name/tag or registry auth
Grafana
the Service ClusterIP
questions.why: describe shows Failed to pull. On kind, confirm Docker can pull the same image.
